name: Teddy's happy picnic
source:
Teddy is a bear who lived in the forest.

He like to picnic, and today he want to have a good picnic.

And maybe make some new friends, that's depending on you.

B̶u̶t̶ ̶w̶a̶i̶t̶,̶ ̶t̶h̶a̶t̶ ̶w̶a̶s̶ ̶w̶a̶y̶ ̶t̶o̶o̶ ̶h̶a̶r̶d̶ ̶f̶o̶r̶ ̶h̶i̶m̶,̶ ̶r̶i̶g̶h̶t̶?̶

[From [url=https://fozybear.itch.io/teddys-happy-picnic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
泰迪是一只住在森林里的熊。

他喜欢野餐，今天也想好好享受一场野餐。

或许还能交到几个新朋友，这就要看你了。

不̶过̶等̶等̶，̶这̶对̶他̶来̶说̶也̶太̶难̶了̶，̶不̶是̶吗̶？̶

[摘自[url=https://fozybear.itch.io/teddys-happy-picnic]Itch.io[/url]]
